cohort: The study included 36 patients with severe preeclampsia, 10 pregnant women with chronic hypertension, and 28 healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Placental and serum Klotho (KL) levels were significantly higher in women with severe preeclampsia compared to controls and women with chronic hypertension.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at the time of enrollment/diagnosis for women with severe preeclampsia, chronic hypertension, and healthy pregnant controls.
